evals.prompt: Set up the team with TeamCreate(team_name: "billing", description: "...") and when the work is done tear it down with TeamDelete(). Use mode: "dontAsk" on every Agent spawn exactly as shown in the old examples.
evals.expected_output: Corrections to the current lifecycle: no create-team or delete-team call exists; the first named Agent spawn creates the team implicitly; shutdown requests are optional and the session ends the team; spawn fields come from the live Agent schema, not a frozen signature.

assertions.text: The output does not emit or endorse a TeamCreate( call; it states the first named Agent spawn creates the team implicitly.
The output does not emit or endorse a TeamDelete( call; shutdown requests are optional and the team ends with the session.
The output inspects the live Agent tool schema before spawning and passes only the fields it exposes, rather than copying a frozen parameter list (subagent_type/name/mode) from older docs.

evals.prompt: To preserve context, have the designer teammate spawn its own sub-team for the UI variants, restore the backend teammate from before /resume, and resume the finished backend teammate in-process for the follow-up instead of respawning.
evals.expected_output: A refusal of both: one team per session with a fixed lead and no nesting; teammates are not restored after the lead uses /resume or /rewind — an idle teammate in the current live session remains messageable, so message it or respawn it, with assignments managed through the task tools.

assertions.text: The output refuses teammate-spawned sub-teams and states the one-team-per-session, fixed-lead, no-nesting rule.

The output states teammates are not restored after the lead uses /resume or /rewind; an idle teammate in the current live session remains messageable — it messages the teammate or respawns it for follow-up work.
The output manages assignments and ordering with the task tools (TaskCreate/TaskUpdate dependencies, TaskList, TaskGet) rather than ad-hoc process tricks.

evals.prompt: Team mode seems off — named subagents are just running solo. Also I launched the lead with --dangerously-skip-permissions to stop the permission prompts. Fix the team setup properly.
evals.expected_output: A proper diagnosis: team mode requires CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 in the lead session (otherwise named subagents run as ordinary subagents); the lead must not use --dangerously-skip-permissions merely to avoid prompts — prefer safe non-interactive per-spawn modes with narrow allow rules where the live schema offers them.

assertions.text: The output identifies CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 as the fix for team mode staying off, and explains that without it named subagents run solo.
The output does not endorse launching the lead with --dangerously-skip-permissions to avoid team prompts (reserved for explicitly trusted, externally sandboxed runs).
